shortDescription: On November 21, 2026 (UTC calendar day), Meteora DLMM recorded daily spot trading volume of $96.819 million, down 37.49% from $155 million seven days earlier. According to Odaily, daily protocol fees were $233,900, down 42.23% from $404,800 over the same period.
